item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find any meaningful sanctions episode to evaluate for 2024.\nI did not find a clean standalone debt-series source in this bounded search; IMF fiscal-consolidation and current-account coverage is the best proxy.\nOverall read: stronger than 2023, but only modestly, and heavily influenced by external normalization, food-price easing, and public-spending support rather than a decisive structural leap.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Executive Board Concludes 2024 Article IV Consultation with the Philippines","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"Dec. 19, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/17/pr-24478-philippines-imf-concludes-2024-article-iv-consultation","summary":"IMF said the authorities handled multiple external headwinds well, growth stayed resilient, inflation fell to 3.2% on average in 2024, the current-account deficit narrowed, and gradual fiscal consolidation was underway. Best single source for “stronger trajectory than inherited,” though the improvement was helped by disinflation and lower commodity prices.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"IMF Staff Completes 2024 Article IV Mission to the Philippines","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"Oct. 3, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/03/pr-24355-philippines-imf-staff-concludes-visit","summary":"Midyear IMF staff said the economy had navigated multiple external headwinds well, growth was expected to reach 6.0% in 2024, inflation was expected to decline to 3.4%, and fiscal consolidation was underway. This supports the argument that the 2024 path was improving even before year-end.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"Highlights of the 2024 Annual Average Inflation","publisher":"Philippine Statistics Authority","date":"2024 annual report","url":"https://psa.gov.ph/price-indices/cpi-ir/node/1684065571","summary":"PSA reported annual average inflation of 3.2% in 2024 versus 6.0% in 2023, with food inflation easing to 4.5% from 8.0%. This is direct evidence that the price environment was materially better by year-end than when Marcos inherited the 2024 shock environment.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"Highlights of the April 2024 Labor Force Survey","publisher":"Philippine Statistics Authority","date":"Jun. 6, 2024","url":"https://psa.gov.ph/content/unemployment-rate-april-2024-was-estimated-40-percent?vcode=2LnTw","summary":"Unemployment fell to 4.0% in April 2024, below April 2023 and January 2024, though underemployment remained elevated. This is a modest positive for trajectory: the labor market was not unraveling despite food-price stress.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"Philippines' budget surplus at P6.3 billion in October","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Nov. 27, 2024","url":"https://interaksyon.philstar.com/business/2024/11/27/287793/philippines-budget-surplus-at-6-3-billion-in-october/","summary":"The government posted a monthly surplus and a smaller year-to-date deficit than a year earlier. That supports a finding of somewhat better fiscal control, though the deficit was still substantial.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"Philippine inflation quickens again in March as rice soars","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Apr. 4, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/philippine-inflation-quickens-again-in-march-as-rice-soars-3366872","summary":"March inflation re-accelerated, rice inflation hit a 15-year high, and the BSP stayed tight. This is the clearest counterweight: 2024 began with a severe food-price shock, so the year’s improvement was not immediate and came under real external pressure.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.8"]},{"title":"Rice tariff intervention had mixed results","publisher":"NEDA/GMA News Online, Department of Agriculture/PNA, BusinessMirror","date":"Dec. 10–11, 2024","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/economy/929579/neda-reduced-rice-tariffs-failed-to-lower-prices/story/ | https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1239750 | https://businessmirror.com.ph/2024/12/10/neda-lower-rice-tariffs-led-to-decline-in-farm-gate-price/","summary":"NEDA said the tariff cut did not lower retail rice prices as anticipated; the DA argued the cut probably prevented an even worse spike amid a weak peso and typhoons; NEDA also reported limited retail pass-through and a significant farm-gate price hit. This is the best evidence that the flagship stabilization tool had only partial success and visible tradeoffs.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.6","5B.8"]}]}
